Peanuts Place by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Peanuts Place, your laid-back home base in the Village of South Walton. This three-bedroom condo sits right between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach – the sweet spot for everything 30A. Spend your mornings exploring local cafes and boutiques, then unwind in the outdoor pool or fire up the shared BBQ for dinner with your crew. Feeling adventurous? Grab a bike and cruise along 30A, or take a sunset stroll to soak in the coastal charm. At Peanuts Place, days are simple, salty, and full of everything that makes 30A special. Oversee 30A is here to make your stay smooth and worry-free. Our local team is available seven days a week, with a 24/7 emergency line if you need us. Overview: - Between Rosemary and Alys Beach - Community pool - 3 bedrooms, 2 baths - .3 mile to beach (private access) - Private Balcony - Wi-Fi - All necessary wristbands included Overnight: - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath - Guest Room: Queen bed, shared bath - Bunk Room: Twin over full bunk, shared bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST.

Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
